from collections import defaultdict
def find_repeats(minlen=18):
    for k in [minlen]:
        d=defaultdict(list)
        for i in range(L-k+1):
            d[seq[i:i+k]].append(i)
        reps=[(km,pos) for km,pos in d.items() if len(pos)>1]
        # extend
        seen=set()
        out=[]
        for km,pos in reps:
            for a in range(len(pos)):
                for b in range(a+1,len(pos)):
                    i,j=pos[a],pos[b]
                    # extend left/right
                    l=i; r=j
                    while l>0 and r>0 and seq[l-1]==seq[r-1]:

                    e1=i+k; e2=j+k
                    while e1<L and e2<L and seq[e1]==seq[e2]:

                    out.append((l,e1,r,e2))
        # dedupe
